comments.text: The contrast between oil riches and large-scale emigration makes Venezuela particularly interesting to understand. What did you learn that challenged your previous assumptions about the country?

replies.author: @GlobalTravelGuide-68
replies.text: @uncensoredworld360  I’m glad the video brought out that complexity. Was there one detail that changed how you previously viewed Venezuela?
